description: This file defines the TransactionRepository class for managing transaction data in a Flutter app's database layer. It provides methods for querying, inserting, updating, deleting, and aggregating transaction records, primarily interacting with an SQLite database through the sqflite plugin.

classes.name: TransactionRepository
classes.description: A repository class that handles CRUD operations and data aggregation for transactions in the database.

methods.name: getByMonth
methods.description: Retrieves all transactions for a specified month, ordered by date and id descending.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Inserts a new transaction record into the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction record based on its id.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a transaction record by its id.

methods.name: totalForMonth
methods.description: Calculates the total sum of amounts for transactions in a specified month.

methods.name: totalsByCategoryForMonth
methods.description: Retrieves the sum of transaction amounts grouped by category for a specific month.
